title: tokens-assets: no peg guard summary in 30m

annotations.summary: The tokens.xyz peg monitor has not completed a run in 30 minutes
annotations.description: No peg_guard_summary log line from refresh-peg-guard in 30 minutes (six missed 5-minute runs). Hypotheses, in order: (1) the run starts but stalls — look for peg_guard_run_failed (reason stage_deadline or exception) and peg_guard_run_stalled lines from the same window; their `stage` names the table or provider the run was waiting on (write_observations = peg_guard_latest, fx_upsert/fx_list = peg_fx_rates_latest, load_fallback = variant_markets_latest, fetch_prices = Birdeye, load_reconcile_state = advisories), and cloudrun_assets_job_stalled/job_failed from the dispatcher carry the same job name; (2) the worker is saturated — 429 'no available instance' on tokens-assets-jobs-prd-us (2 instances x concurrency 2) means Cloud Scheduler hit the 90s attempt deadline before the handler ran, so no job line exists at all; check the scheduler run history for DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; (3) the Cloud Scheduler job itself is failing (run history + HTTP status); (4) PEG_GUARD_ENABLED is not 'true' on the assets worker (the handler returns disabled without a summary); (5) BIRDEYE_API_KEY is missing (the whole depeg job group is then absent); (6) the worker is down. While the peg guard is silent every USD stablecoin Webacy does not cover (all but USDC, USDT and PYUSD) has no live peg status, and any advisory the peg guard set stays in place until it runs again.
